description: This file defines the AlertsViewDefault class which extends SugarView. It provides methods for preparing and displaying alert views in the SuiteCRM application, including assigning configuration variables and rendering a template.

classes.name: AlertsViewDefault
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView, responsible for rendering alert-related interfaces in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters for the alert view, defaulting to 'Alerts'.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: A placeholder method called before displaying the view, currently does nothing.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Assigns configuration variables to the Smarty template engine and renders the JSON template for alerts.
